svg.title: Switch players from the Autodarts page
svg.desc: In fullscreen or kiosk mode, a tap on the round button in a corner of the Autodarts page, or the keyboard shortcut, opens the switcher over the page. It is a page of the extension in a frame, so the page can't read the accounts. A tap on a player, or the keys 1 to 9, switches; on a match page the switcher asks first, before any token is spent, and the page reloads as the chosen player.
